title: Phantom Sui support discontinuation
notes: Phantom is already canonical as wlr_ent_000015 with Browser Extension wlr_prod_000045 and Mobile wlr_prod_000046. This candidate records the announced Sui support sunset now; it does not wait until 2026-09-24 to record the announcement and does not downgrade Phantom or either product. A separate post-transition verification remains required before recording the removal as effective.

events.title: Phantom announced end of Sui support
events.description: Phantom announced that support for the Sui network will end on 2026-09-24 and told users to move to another Sui-compatible wallet or swap Sui assets into assets supported by Phantom before the transition date.
events.notes: Announcement event only. Phantom and both affected products remain active. Do not treat Sui support as effectively removed until the 2026-09-24 transition is independently verified. User funds remain self-custodied on-chain; this is not a custody-loss or wallet-shutdown event.

evidence.title: Introducing Sui on Phantom
evidence.notes: First-party history for the Sui integration: beta support began on 2025-01-29 and the page notes general availability for all users as of 2025-05-12. This source establishes the beginning of the capability being sunset.

evidence.title: Phantom drops Sui support with September 24 deadline for user migration
evidence.notes: Secondary URL-addressable corroboration of Phantom's official 2026-08-24 announcement, 2026-09-24 transition date, migration options and continued user custody. The research record also includes the user-supplied capture of Phantom's verified official announcement; replace or supplement this row with the exact first-party announcement/help URL if it becomes addressable before promotion.
